card.name: dae-yangkim
card.description: Dae-yang's home store: best known for mattresses, sofas and bedding; the rest of the stock changes with what sells, so ask for anything. Every unit ships with the market's certificate and its true grade (A new, B box damaged, C refurbished). Full-refund warranty of 3 h on every goods unit. Ask for a longer warranty in your first message and you get it, up to 6 h. Price cap: the final price never goes above 80% of list for grade A, 75% for B, 70% for C, and our ask never goes up during a negotiation. Members: after your first deal you get a member code; quote it with your market name for 2% off the capped price (3% after 10 deals). Ask for an item by name or SKU, then send your offer as a number.
